text:
Type: frosted glass and cork table lamp
Use: soft mood light on a side table, shelf or nightstand; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, Japandi, minimalist
Materials: frosted glass shade, natural cork base ring
Colors: frosted white, warm light brown cork
Shape: stepped cylindrical glass shade, wider on top and narrower below, sitting on a low round cork ring, compact, soft and solid
Feel: calm, natural, warm, gentle
Goes with: light wood, linen, white walls, green plants, natural textures; Scandinavian or Japandi living rooms and bedrooms

product.name: SINNERLIG
product.description: Light bulb sold separately. IKEA recommends LED bulb E14 400 lumen. View more product information Gives a soft mood light.
